While searching for Silence Suzuka, who 
hadn't shown up for training—

...I spotted Silence Suzuka turning to the 
left while groaning softly under her 
breath.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"I have an English vocab test tomorrow. I 
always get scolded for low scores, so..."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"I was trying to figure out how I could 
study for tests while running, but—"
